stem: One identified harvest batch is divided into three new containers with new identifiers. Which record best preserves genealogy through the split?
choices: Record only the three new container IDs because the source batch has already been harvested
Link each new container ID to the same source batch and record the split event with required time, location, quantity or count, and responsible record
Keep the source label on one container and let the other two inherit identity by proximity
Delete the original batch record once the three new containers are created
rationale: A split creates multiple outputs from one identified input. Traceability is preserved when each new identity remains linked to the source through the event record rather than replacing or discarding the earlier genealogy.
